prerequisites: PLC is powered on and in test mode. | DI_CHWP01_Fault is set to 0 (no fault). | DI_CHWP02_Fault is set to 0 (no fault). | SYS_RunRequest is set to 1 (run request active). | SYS_PostRunActive is set to 1 (post run active). | SYS_LeadPump1Selected is set to 1 (pump 1 is selected).

Normal control The active chilled-water pump speed command shall target 20.0 psi differential pressure and shall be clamped between 30 and 100 percent. Shutdown and protective behavior Normal loss of cooling demand stops the AHUs and initiates a 120-second pump and valve post-run.
